## Fixed beams and blocking signals for the voice chain. Pure C: the host harness in
## tools/chain_harness compiles the same sources for x86.
add_library(fph_chain_beams INTERFACE)
target_sources(fph_chain_beams
    INTERFACE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/chain_beams.c
)
target_include_directories(fph_chain_beams
    INTERFACE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/api
)
target_link_libraries(fph_chain_beams
    INTERFACE
        lib_xcore_math
)

## src/chain_beams_tables.h and ../chain_picker/src/chain_picker_tables.h are generated by
## satellite's prototype/chain/gen_g3_tables.py and committed; configuration stops if either
## was edited by hand.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tables_check.cmake)
chain_tables_check(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/chain_beams_tables.h CHAIN_BEAMS_TABLES_SHA256)

add_library(fph::chain_beams ALIAS fph_chain_beams)
